newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian police seize heroin worth $65 million.
newsitem.headline: Italian police seize heroin worth $65 million.

text.p: Italian police said on Saturday they had smashed a drugs smuggling ring, arresting five people and seizing 120 kg (240 lbs) of heroin with a street value of some $65 million.
Finance police in Naples and Milan said they made the arrests after discovering the heroin hidden in a car and a lorry in the southern port city.
They said the believed the ring was led by Pasquale Gallo, 40, who was arrested this week in the nearby town of Torre Annunziata on drugs charges.

The operation stemmed from a probe begun last May after the arrest of a Turkish smuggler who was carrying 600 million lire ($396,000) in cash wrapped in paper from a Naples pastry shop, police said. ($1=1,514 lire)
